newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Manley ill, Carter cancels visit to Jamaica.
newsitem.headline: Manley ill, Carter cancels visit to Jamaica.

text.p: Former U.S. President Jimmy Carter cancelled his planned visit to former Jamaican Prime Minister Michael Manley after Manley's doctors advised him against having visitors at this time, a spokesman said on Friday.
Manley, who is battling cancer, wrote to Carter on Thursday saying he hoped to recover sufficiently to see him and his wife soon.

Carter is on a three-nation tour of Latin America ahead of a conference to be held at the Carter Centre in April on the region's future. He was to have arrived in Jamaica on Saturday for a private visit with Manley and a meeting with Prime Minister P.J. Patterson prior to returning home.
Manley has been bedridden for a month, and was last seen in public over six months ago.
